text:
Jae Park: Heads-up — Keystone Analytics usage down ~48% this month, procurement engaging, new ML lead asking for a bakeoff. Saw spike in seat inactivity since onboarding week 6.
account-bot: [ALERT] usage_drop threshold crossed (48%)
Riley Gomez: any idea when procurement first pinged? can you drop the last 90d token counts?
Jae Park: they flagged on their internal call yesterday. I pulled quick numbers — see below.
Samir Patel: ```30d active users: 12 -> 6
30d avg tokens/day: 240k -> 125k
recent onboarding cohort: 8 users, 3 active
queries per session dropped 40%```
Leah Chen: ouch. who's the new ML lead? do we have notes on competitive requirements?
Mika: @Jae Park can you add stakeholder map? need names for procurement + ML + security.
Jae Park: new ML lead is Priya Rao, replaced Alex two weeks ago. Procurement lead is Tom K. Security not engaged yet.
Riley Gomez: sounds like classic feature-for-cost ask. Do we know which vendor they are evaluating? any timeline?
Samir Patel: they mentioned "NimbusAI" in the call and want latency/cost benchmarks by EOW.
Leah Chen: propose short playbook: 1) urgent call with Priya + Tom (this week) 2) show targeted benchmarks (p50/p95 latency, cost per 1k tokens) 3) offer a 2-week pilot on Dedicated with a small discount 4) enablement session for Priya's team 5) QBR with exec sponsor
Mika: I'll prepare stakeholder outreach template and client one-pager. assignable to @Leah for enablement content?
Leah Chen: happy to own enablement. @Samir can you run a quick p95 latency/cost sweep using their 512-context trace and share numbers?
Samir Patel: on it. will run two model configs (base-quant, quant-8) and share by 5pm PST.
Jae Park: I'll schedule the call with Priya and Tom for Thu 10am PT. tagging @Riley for renewal notes and pricing lead.
Riley Gomez: added to calendar. We should prep a fallback plan if Nimbus offers a lower list price — maybe a usage rebate tied to retention.
Leah Chen: also capture top 3 prompts they rely on so we can show quality parity. can someone export sample prompts? @Mika?
Mika: exporting now, will drop sanitized examples in thread.
account-bot: note created: renewal_risk_keystone_1795012345, priority: high
Samir Patel: dropped numbers: ```p50 latency base: 110ms, p95: 220ms
quant-8 p50: 125ms, p95: 240ms
est cost per 1k tokens base: $1.12, quant-8: $0.72```
Leah Chen: great. I'll build the slide: comparison table + suggested pilot terms. plan: 2-week dedicated pilot + enablement + exec QBR.
Jae Park: next steps assigned: Leah (enablement + slides), Samir (benchmarks), Mika (prompts + stakeholder doc), Riley (commercial fallback). I'll follow up after Thu call. thanks team :thumbsup:
Riley Gomez: thanks — keep me posted. If we need legal/discount signoff, ping me.
Jae Park: last note — procurement asked for data retention policy doc. @Mika can we attach KMS/HSM summary?
Mika: yes, will attach a short KMS/HSM & VPC note before the call.
Leah Chen: copy. meet Thu, prepare battle card against Nimbus (latency, price, support) :muscle:
Jae Park: thread closing unless new intel. I'll post call notes afterwards.
